mission: Pre-Centerpoint-operation command briefing — Klauskin runs through the operational sequence while the ghost of his dead wife whispers.
why_now: The Centerpoint commando operation is imminent.
opening_hook: Klauskin at a briefing lectern on the flagship with officers arrayed in front of him.
conflict: Klauskin's professional composure against the hallucination pressure.
turning_point: Klauskin holds the briefing together; only the reader sees how close he is to collapse.
closing_hook: Klauskin leaving the briefing room, passing the chair his wife is, in his private mind, seated in.
setting: Flagship briefing room, en route to Corellian space.
sensory_details: Briefing holos; officers' shined boots; the chair in Klauskin's head.

stakes.interpersonal: The officers' trust in his composure.

notes: The chapter's first half builds Klauskin's fragility.
